fusions.name: Chewed-Up Terms
fusions.desc: A bite that needs one of your afflictions on the target and eats it, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bleated Proclamation
fusions.desc: Bellows a proclamation that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each one 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Paperweight Stance
fusions.desc: Weighs you down as a paperweight: the damage you take is reduced by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Grudge List
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, you add the offence to your list, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per entry (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, an entry fades every 10 seconds.
